metadata.question: Does the snow cover extent in the Tinguiririca basin (specifically -34.752733, -70.647985) on December 18, 2023, exceed the average snow cover observed on December 18 from 2017 to 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS daily snow cover (MOD10A1 or MYD10A1) for 2023-12-18 and the historical period 2017-2022-12-18. - Product: `MODIS/006/MOD10A1` (Terra Daily Snow) – band “NDSI_Snow_Cover” (0–100 %). - Geometry: 5 km radius buffer around the point (-34.752733, -70.647985) to capture basin-scale snow extent. - Snow cover % ≥ 50 is typically treated as “snow-covered”; here we simply sum the % pixels to get total snow cover extent within the ROI. 2. Masking: The official“SummaryQA” band must be 0 (good quality) before including a pixel in the sum. 3. Logic: - 2023-12-18 single image vs mean of 2017-2022-12-18 images. - Compute total snow cover % sum inside ROI for every year. - If 2023 sum > historical-mean sum ⇒ A (Yes), else B (No). - If any image collection is empty ⇒ C1. - After QA masking, if all years have 0 valid pixels ⇒ C2. - If any result is None/NaN ⇒ C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-70.647985, -34.752733]) roi = pt.buffer(5000) def annual_snow(year): col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1')\ .filterDate(f'{year}-12-18', f'{year}-12-19')\ .select(['NDSI_Snow_Cover', 'SummaryQA']) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: return None img = col.first() qa = img.select('SummaryQA') snow = img.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover').updateMask(qa.eq(0)) tot = snow.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('NDSI_Snow_Cover') return tot.getInfo() hist = [annual_snow(y) for y in range(2017, 2023)] if any(v is None for v in hist): print("Missing historical image") print("C1") import sys; sys.exit() v2023 = annual_snow(2023) if v2023 is None: print("No 2023 image") print("C1") import sys; sys.exit() avg = sum(hist) / len(hist) pix = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1').filterDate('2023-12-18', '2023-12-19')\ .first().select('NDSI_Snow_Cover').updateMask( ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1').filterDate('2023-12-18', '2023-12-19') .first().select('SummaryQA').eq(0))\ .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9)\ .get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo() print(f"2023 snow sum: {v2023:.1f}, hist mean: {avg:.1f}, valid pixels: {int(pix)}") if pix == 0: print("C2") elif v2023 is None or avg is None: print("C3") else: print("A" if v2023 > avg else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-70.647985, -34.752733])
roi = pt.buffer(5000)

def annual_snow(year):
    col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1')\
            .filterDate(f'{year}-12-18', f'{year}-12-19')\
            .select(['NDSI_Snow_Cover', 'SummaryQA'])
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None
    img = col.first()
    qa = img.select('SummaryQA')
    snow = img.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover').updateMask(qa.eq(0))
    tot = snow.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=roi,
        scale=500,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('NDSI_Snow_Cover')
    return tot.getInfo()

hist = [annual_snow(y) for y in range(2017, 2023)]
if any(v is None for v in hist):
    print("Missing historical image")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    import sys; sys.exit()

v2023 = annual_snow(2023)
if v2023 is None:
    print("No 2023 image")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    import sys; sys.exit()

avg = sum(hist) / len(hist)
pix = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1').filterDate('2023-12-18', '2023-12-19')\
        .first().select('NDSI_Snow_Cover').updateMask(
            ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1').filterDate('2023-12-18', '2023-12-19')
            .first().select('SummaryQA').eq(0))\
        .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9)\
        .get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo()

print(f"2023 snow sum: {v2023:.1f}, hist mean: {avg:.1f}, valid pixels: {int(pix)}")
if pix == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif v2023 is None or avg is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if v2023 > avg else "<answer>B</answer>")
